I fixed the format-spec parser in `youtube_dl/YoutubeDL.py` (`build_format_selector`), and all 14 tests in `test/test_YoutubeDL.py` now pass.

The bug was in the `/` (fallback choice) branch. It appended the finished choice to the selector list and set the current selector to `None`. A following `,`, as in `bestvideo/best,bestaudio`, then appended that `None` as well, and building the selector function crashed on it.

Now the `/` branch keeps the choice as the current selector instead of appending it right away. The existing end-of-loop and `,` handling then adds it exactly once.
